desc: Derive an exact identity expressing \(f(x)\) as weighted divisibility indicators and reduce the target sum to per-modulus divisible-pair sum totals.
For every modulus \(2^k\), compute the total \(A_i+A_j\) over unordered pairs \(i\le j\) whose sum is divisible by \(2^k\), using complementary residue count/sum aggregates without double counting.
Implement the resulting \(O(N\log \max A)\) Python algorithm with safe integer arithmetic and fast input.
Validate self-pairs, self-complementary residues, all-equal values, mixed parity, and the provided samples.
